<!--
  The loading state of a page: grey blocks in the shape of the content that is coming (cards, a list of rows or
  an article). Axes: shape (cards, list, article), tone. The label tells assistive technology that the content
  is loading. The shimmer itself belongs to the Skeleton part.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Line } from "./skeleton-layout.types";

export type SkeletonLayoutProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  label: string;
  lines: Line[];
  shape?: "cards" | "list" | "article";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Skeleton from "../primitives/skeleton/skeleton.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const { id, title, label, lines, shape = "cards", tone = "default" } = defineProps<SkeletonLayoutProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" density="default">
    <Block tag="div" class="w-full" role="status" :aria-label="label" data-testid="skeleton" :data-shape="shape">
      <Grid v-if="((shape as string) === 'cards')" cols="1-3" class="gap-4">
        <Stack
          v-for="l in lines"
          :key="l.id"
          gap="4"
          class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4"
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <Skeleton class="aspect-video w-full" />
          <Skeleton class="h-4 w-2/3" />
          <Skeleton class="h-4 w-full" />
        </Stack>
      </Grid>
      <Stack v-else-if="((shape as string) === 'list')" gap="4" align="stretch">
        <Group v-for="l in lines" :key="l.id" gap="4" align="center" data-testid="item">
          <Skeleton class="size-10 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
          <Stack gap="2" class="flex-1">
            <Skeleton class="h-4 w-1/3" />
            <Skeleton class="h-4 w-full" />
          </Stack>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
      <Stack v-else gap="4" align="stretch" class="mx-auto max-w-2xl">
        <Skeleton class="h-8 w-3/4" />
        <Stack v-for="l in lines" :key="l.id" gap="2" data-testid="item">
          <Skeleton class="h-4 w-full" />
          <Skeleton class="h-4 w-5/6" />
        </Stack>
      </Stack>
    </Block>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
